owner_directive: Implement ADR-055 Spec 3 (local startup modes and background runtime) per issue #2280 owner decisions, which override the spec: (1) splash offers Desktop / External AI at every launch with a don't-ask-again option, remembered choice changeable later from the menu and tray, desktop gives today's flow; (2) tray icon only in external-AI mode (open connection window, copy address, service status, open in desktop mode, stop and quit; macOS template image; Linux without tray host reaches the running instance via second-instance); (3) backend stops with Electron: POSIX watchdog unchanged, drop --no-parent-watchdog, instance adoption and runtime-port.js discovery changes; verify on Windows that the non-detached backend dies when Electron is force-killed and add a Windows backstop only if it does not; explicit stop via existing stopRuntime; (4) one backend per machine, second-instance reveals the connection window or attaches a desktop window; (5) OTA stop-then-relaunch includes the background instance and the relaunch honors the mode. Out of scope: worker/grandchild cleanup (#2281), OS autostart, lab deployment, AI-host presentation.
